Saudi-led coalition strikes Houthi targets amid regional tensions

The Saudi-led coalition announced it had destroyed over 100 Houthi military targets in response to attacks on civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. Singapore condemned the Houthi attacks on aviation infrastructure. Separately, a Houthi chief released a video alleging secret relations between Saudi Arabia and Israel. Syria is reportedly considering support for Saudi efforts against the Houthis.
